integrity: The exact covariance is derived directly from independence of future increments and symmetry of each partial sum. The marginal occupation variance is supplied by the classical Sparre-Andersen discrete arcsine law. The asymptotic constant follows from the central limit theorem plus uniform integrability. The checker replays the covariance identity by exhaustive lattice enumeration and verifies the arcsine moments algebraically.
scientific_limitations: The universal finite occupation-count distribution uses iid continuous symmetric increments; lattice walks require a tie convention and need not have the same finite marginal law.
Finite nonzero variance is required for the correlation limit; the exact covariance identity only needs integrable symmetric independent increments.
The result gives mixed first moments and a correlation limit, not the full joint law of occupation count and terminal displacement.
title: Positive-sojourn count has a universal terminal correlation
